If I am not wrong this can cause some problems when running the test framework with `--randomseed=`. As same seed could produce different results, making errors non reproducible. This is because the seed is not applied into the rng before you call a function.

A solution to this would be to not use an rng for this test and hardcode some value.
For example:

diff --git a/test/functional/wallet_miniscript.py b/test/functional/wallet_miniscript.py

@@ -10,9 +10,8 @@ from test_framework.psbt import PSBT, PSBT_IN_SHA256

-TPRVS = [ExtendedPrivateKey.generate().to_string() for _ in range(0, 3)]

+TPUBS = [ExtendedPrivateKey.from_seed(f"miniscript-public-{i}".encode()).pubkey().to_string() for i in range(7)]
